meta.name: javascript-sdk
meta.description: JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for inference.sh - run AI apps, build agents, integrate 250+ models. Package: @inferencesh/sdk (npm install). Full TypeScript support, streaming, file uploads. Build agents with template or ad-hoc patterns, tool builder API, skills, human approval. Use for: JavaScript integration, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, frontend apps. Triggers: javascript sdk, typescript sdk, npm install, node.js api, js client, react ai, next.js ai, frontend sdk, @inferencesh/sdk, typescript agent, browser sdk, js integration

copy.tagline: 在 JavaScript/TypeScript 项目中集成 AI 推理与 agent 构建
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 JS/TS 开发应用并需要调用 AI 模型或构建 agent。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate AI inference and build agents in JavaScript/TypeScript projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop apps in JS/TS and need to call AI models or build agents.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以使用 JavaScript/TypeScript SDK 调用 inference.sh 平台上的 250 多个 AI 应用，运行 AI 任务、构建智能体、上传文件、处理流式响应，并支持工具构建和人工审批。
howto.when: 当用户提到“JavaScript SDK”、“TypeScript SDK”、“npm install”等关键词，或要求集成 AI 到前端应用（如 React、Next.js）时触发。

say.text: 用 JavaScript SDK 运行一个图像生成应用，提示词是“日落”。
say.note: Claude 会调用 SDK 的 run 方法执行指定应用。

say.text: 帮我创建一个智能体，使用 Claude Sonnet 4 作为核心模型。
上传一个文件到 inference.sh 并获取它的 URI。
say.note: Claude 会使用 uploadFile 方法上传文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the JavaScript/TypeScript SDK to call 250+ AI apps on inference.sh, run AI tasks, build agents, upload files, handle streaming responses, and support tool building with human approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "JavaScript SDK", "TypeScript SDK", "npm install", or asks to integrate AI into frontend apps (e.g., React, Next.js).

say_en.text: Run an image generation app using the JavaScript SDK with prompt 'sunset'.
say_en.note: Claude will call the SDK's run method to execute the app.

say_en.text: Create an agent using Claude Sonnet 4 as the core model.
say_en.note: Claude will use the Agent SDK to build an ad-hoc agent.

say_en.text: Upload a file to inference.sh and get its URI.
say_en.note: Claude will use the uploadFile method to upload the file.
